ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier. When supplied and found, the existing instance is updated.

Source.description: Tool instance source identifier that defines the shape of the instance. Required when creating a new instance.

Name.description: Unique tool instance name. Used to derive the function name exposed to the AI model and cannot change once created.

Description.description: Description the AI model uses to decide when to call the instance.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp to preserve during import.

Author.description: Optional author name recorded with the instance.

BaseUrl.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL the request targets.

HttpMethod.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

AuthenticationType.description: Authentication type: None, ApiKey, Basic, or OAuth2.

ApiKeyHeaderName.description: Header name used to send the API key when AuthenticationType is ApiKey.

ApiKey.description: API key credential. Stored encrypted at rest.

BearerToken.description: Bearer token credential. Stored encrypted at rest.

Password.description: Basic authentication password. Stored encrypted at rest.

ClientSecret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret. Stored encrypted at rest.

DefaultHeaders.description: Static headers always added to the request.

AllowModelProvidedPath.description: Whether the AI model may supply a relative path.

AllowModelProvidedQuery.description: Whether the AI model may supply query string parameters.

AllowModelProvidedBody.description: Whether the AI model may supply a request body.

TimeoutSeconds.description: Per-request timeout in seconds. Leave empty to use the default.

BaseUrl.description: Root URL of the documentation site.

SitemapUrl.description: Explicit sitemap URL. Leave empty to derive it from the base URL.

MaxResults.description: Maximum passages returned for a single search.

MaxPages.description: Maximum pages the crawler indexes for this site.

SitemapDocumentationToolSettings.description: Settings for the built-in sitemap documentation search source.

BaseUrl.description: Root URL of the documentation site.

IndexUrl.description: Explicit prebuilt search index URL. Leave empty to derive it from the base URL.

MaxResults.description: Maximum passages returned for a single search.

SearchIndexDocumentationToolSettings.description: Settings for the built-in prebuilt search index documentation source.

ApiKey.description: Algolia search-only API key. Stored encrypted at rest.

MaxResults.description: Maximum passages returned for a single search.

AlgoliaDocumentationToolSettings.description: Settings for the built-in Algolia DocSearch documentation source.

BaseUrl.description: Root URL of the site to search (for example https://www.example.com).

SearchPath.description: Search endpoint path appended to the base URL. Defaults to the WordPress REST search endpoint.

QueryParameter.description: Query-string parameter that carries the model's free-text query. Defaults to 'search'.

ExtraQuery.description: Fixed extra query-string parameters always appended to the request. Defaults to '_embed=1'.

ResultsPath.description: Dotted path to the results array in the response. Empty means the response body is itself the array.

TitlePath.description: Dotted path, relative to each result, to the result title. Defaults to 'title'.

UrlPath.description: Dotted path, relative to each result, to the result URL. Defaults to 'url'.

SnippetPath.description: Dotted path, relative to each result, to the text snippet. Defaults to the embedded WordPress excerpt.

MaxResults.description: Maximum results returned for a single search.

WebsiteSearchToolSettings.description: Settings for the built-in live website search source.

DataSourceId.description: Identifier of the AI data source the instance searches.

RetrievalMode.description: Whether a search returns only the matching chunks or the full source documents they belong to.

TopNDocuments.description: Number of top-scoring documents returned for a single search. Empty uses the site default.

Strictness.description: Relevance threshold a result must clear to be returned. Empty uses the site default.

Filter.description: OData filter expression translated to the index provider's own syntax before the search runs.

DataSourceSearchToolSettings.description: Settings for the built-in AI data source vector search source.

Name.description: Parameter name. For model-filled parameters this is the property name in the function schema and must be a valid identifier, unique within the instance.

Description.description: Natural-language description shown to the AI model. Required for model-filled parameters.

Type.description: JSON schema type of the parameter.

Fill.description: Who supplies the value at invocation time: Model (the AI model), Fixed (a pinned value), or Context (resolved server-side from the request context).

Required.description: Whether the AI model must supply the value. Only meaningful when Fill is Model.

DefaultValue.description: Value applied when the model omits an optional parameter, or the pinned value when Fill is Fixed. A Fixed secret value is stored encrypted at rest.

AllowedValues.description: Closed set of accepted values, emitted as the schema enum and enforced by the binder. Empty means any value of the declared type.

ContextKey.description: Well-known context key resolved when Fill is Context, for example user.id.

Binding.description: Source-specific placement of the resolved value, expressed as Target or Target:name (for example Query:orderId). Valid targets are declared by the owning source.

IsSecret.description: Whether a Fixed value is a credential. Secret values are stored encrypted at rest and never returned to the UI in clear text.

Parameters.description: The declared parameters, in the order they appear in the function schema the AI model sees.

AIToolInstanceParametersMetadata.description: User-declared parameters for sources that opt into parameter support.

Properties.description: Source-specific tool instance settings, grouped by settings object name. Secrets are stored encrypted at rest.

instances.description: The AI tool instances to create or update.
